title: Maximum Subarray Sum
statement:
Find the largest sum over all non-empty contiguous slices of an array.

Contract
- `numbers` is non-null and has at least one element; values may be any `int`.
- A subarray is a non-empty run of adjacent elements. Return the largest sum of any subarray.
- Sums can exceed the `int` range, so the result is a `long`. Do not mutate `numbers`.

Examples
- `maxSubarraySum(new int[]{3, -5, 4, 2, -1, 6, -8})` returns `11`.
- `maxSubarraySum(new int[]{-7, -3, -9})` returns `-3`.
- `maxSubarraySum(new int[]{5})` returns `5`.
hints: Consider the best subarray that ends exactly at each index.
A running total that has gone negative can only hurt the next subarray, so restart from the current element instead.
Track the best sum ending here and the best seen so far, starting from the first element rather than zero. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space, where n is the array length.
inputSyntax: Input: the array values (at least one), for example: [3, -5, 4, 2, -1, 6, -8]
